title: dash-server
tagline: Agent-operated Dash hosting for live dashboards on your database.
role: An add-on that hosts Dash apps against the local database. Your AI agent drives it through its MCP control plane while you watch the result in a browser.
url: http://127.0.0.1:5100 by default. If something else already holds that port the install moves to the next free one and records it - so to see where yours is actually serving, run dash-server: it prints the address, and if a copy is already up it says so and prints that one's address rather than starting a second.
control_plane: The same address with /mcp on the end.
installed_by: Never by the installer. Only through exakit marketplace.
db_user: Reuses the kit's read-only mcp_readonly user - dashboards read, they do not write.

quickstart.note: Space selects dash-server, Enter installs it. That is the whole install.
It prints the address it is serving on. Run it again any time you need that address - an already-running copy reports itself instead of starting a second one.
Ask your AI agent. It drives the control plane while you watch the page in a browser.

commands.description: A second copy will not bind: the first one (often started at login) is already serving.

commands.summary: Starts the database and every service, including this one.
Shows running, stopped, or the port held by someone else.
Update it, and regenerate its launcher.

environment.name: EXAKIT_DASH_SERVER_PORT
environment.effect: Serve on a different port: EXAKIT_DASH_SERVER_PORT=5200 exakit update dash-server.

notes: Not sure which port yours is on? Run dash-server. It prints the address, whether it starts one or finds one already running.
If port 5100 is taken at install time the kit moves to the next free port and records it.
The launcher stores only the PATH of the credential file, never the password, and reads it fresh at run time.

troubleshooting.symptom: It looks like a crash on start
troubleshooting.remedy: A second copy cannot bind the port. The first one is already serving - check exakit status.

troubleshooting.symptom: The control plane answers but the page is blank or 500
troubleshooting.remedy: exakit logs dash-server -f while you reload the page.
